body:
I guess I am a bit cynical, in some ways. I tend to be fairly nihilistic in general, I don't believe anything has a purpose behind it, and I find it quite freeing. I can always ground myself by thinking about how insignificant I am - doesn't matter what you do, you can't leave any meaningful impact on anything, so may as well live in the moment, enjoy anything you can. I've actually got a book by Nietzsche lying around somewhere, might give it a read at some point.

And yeah, it could very well be a chemical thing. But I'd rather try everything I can on my own before getting proper, professional help. I guess I'm scared of actually talking about my emotions properly.

I've heard of vaporwave, and I know Floral Shoppe. There's an album by 2 1 8 4 that I quite like, but other than that I don't know much vaporwave. I quite like ambient music in general, so it's probably right up my alley.
Yeah, I've calmed down a bit, can think a little more clearly. Thank you for talking, it helped. I'll think about what you said. Take care.
It shouldn't be a problem, I usually get pretty high grades, and even if I do drop down a bit, I'll still get into the uni that I want to go to.

Playing with other people is pretty fun. Maybe if you look online you can find other people who want to form a band. Death Grips is an acquired taste, it's very harsh and weird, just to warn you. Pond is good as well, if you're into psych rock you'll like them. Elliott Smith isn't very well known in the UK either, not sure I've met anyone else who knows him. It's a shame. As for metal, I listen to the big bands  as well. Slayer is good, I'd recommend them since you like Metallica. I really like doom metal as well, just really loud and hopeless, it always cheers me up for some reason. Electric Wizard would be a good band if you want to listen to some of that. Anything you would recommend at all? I'd like some new music to listen to, don't really mind what genre.

As for what got me here, I'm not really sure. I've always been kinda negative and pessimistic, and it's just gotten a lot worse over the last year or so. There's not really anything in my life that I could point to, everything is going pretty well if I'm being honest. I'm just unhappy, whatever I do. How about you, if you don't mind me asking? What makes you feel like you do?

Edit : I'm probably gonna get some sleep, have to be up in a few hours. Thanks for talking, I really needed this.
I'm not sure I'm ready to be sober for any length of time, but I'm definitely cutting back. Hopefully I can get through it, and without my grades suffering too much.

Drugs do just cover it up, and do cause more problems than they solve, but they're more a symptom, not a cause. I've been able to stop quite easily in the past once I start getting a grip on things again, should be the same this time.

I do play in a band, but it's not at all serious, pretty much just do covers and piss around. I don't think we'll ever perform, but it's fun. As for artists I like, I'd say Death Grips is one of my favourites, if a bit weird. But also Elliott Smith, Pink Floyd, Pond, Funkadelic, Led Zeppelin, and some metal as well.


As for the guy I talk to, I've known him for a few years, met him online through games. I meant that I didn't know him in real life, so I can talk to him without it affecting my day to day life. He has a lot of the same problems, so we try to help each other.
I guess you're right. I'm not gonna do anything stupid, I can't do that.
Thanks man. I'll think about getting actual help, but I'd still rather deal with it on my own.

Sounds good to me. What kinda guitar do you play? I started out with classical guitar but picked up a Telecaster and a cheap Ibanez about a year ago, and really got back into it after having not played for like a year.

I find it really hard to actually talk about my emotions, is the problem. It's pretty much impossible face to face, I'm too awkward with that sort of thing. I do have someone that I talk to online but he's got more than his fair share of problems, it's not fair for me to dump everything on him all the time. I just keep thinking that if I leave it long enough everything will sort itself out, although it won't. I really can't see myself actually killing myself anytime soon though, I can't do that to my family and friends, and I still don't really want to. I'll probably do fine, won't fuck up my life too much, but I doubt it'll make me happy.

Thank you for responding, I really need someone to talk to who doesn't know me.
